news.aboutBody: AutoCap Group is an entrepreneur-driven group that invests in and develops tire service centres across the Nordics. The company is headquartered in Stockholm. The business model is built on acquiring well-run workshops and giving them access to shared resources across several areas such as logistics, purchasing, marketing and training. At the same time, the local workshop's entrepreneurial spirit is preserved. Most workshop owners become co-owners in the group and continue to run their operations with a high degree of autonomy. AutoCap Group places particular emphasis on preserving and developing each individual workshop and its employees.

investors.title: Building the Nordic tire services platform
investors.lead: AutoCap Group is consolidating Sweden's independent tire service industry. 13 workshops across 7 companies acquired in 15 months, around SEK 200 million in revenue, local brands and teams retained.

case.title: The investment case
case.p1Text: Around 2,200 companies service tires in Sweden; about 97 % turn over less than SEK 100 million and the largest players hold under 5 %. The market is worth around SEK 15 billion and growing. Few owners have a succession plan – we acquire local leaders and keep their brands.
case.p2Text: Tire services are non-discretionary and safety-critical. Every car needs two tire changes a year, and tire hotels, around 38 % of the market, keep customers coming back to the same workshop season after season. Stable, cash-generative and predictable.
case.p3Text: 13 workshops in 7 companies acquired in 15 months, in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Vänersborg. Sellers reinvest in AutoCap shares, so the people who built the workshops stay owners. Shared procurement, central finance and digital systems lift margins, and local brands and teams stay.
case.p4Text: Our leadership combines fifteen years inside the European tire industry, two decades of company building and M&A, CFO experience from listed and PE-backed groups, and more than 30 years of running tire workshops. Backed by a board with deep experience in M&A, financing and company building.

model.title: How we acquire
model.s1Text: Profitable, owner-led workshops with a local reputation. Name, team and customers stay.
model.s2Text: Sellers become shareholders in the group. The people who built the workshops stay owners.
model.s3Text: Central finance, procurement, digital systems and a regional organisation: East and West/Central.

cluster.title: Density, not footprint
cluster.text1: We do not buy workshops one by one across the map. We build clusters of workshops in a region, close enough to share tire hotels, logistics, staff in peak season and purchasing. Each region has its own leadership, so the platform can absorb new acquisitions without management becoming the bottleneck.
cluster.text2: Two regions today, drawn along county borders. New regions open where a lead workshop can anchor a cluster.
cluster.eastText: workshops · Stockholm, Uppsala, Västmanland, Södermanland, Östergötland
cluster.westText: workshops · Västra Götaland, Örebro, Jönköping and westwards
cluster.b1Text: Workshops close enough to work as one unit
cluster.b2Text: Tire hotel capacity, transport, seasonal staff, purchasing
cluster.b3Text: Every acquisition integrated locally in its first 100 days
